title: Aether metric-to-source coverage matrix
evidence_status: documentation/design only; no implementation or deployment validation

route_definitions.E: Existing endpoint: documented in-scope source route; feature/schema/scope still require deployment verification.
route_definitions.R: Derived: calculation over named inputs. Input acquisition and missing evidence are separate dependencies; this is not an availability claim.
route_definitions.H: Host/device/fabric collector: collection outside core engine endpoints, including an external switch integration where specified.
route_definitions.I: Application/library/device tracing integration: semantic records or profiling beyond established core endpoints; may require workload configuration or process instrumentation.
route_definitions.U: Unresolved mapping: the source or its measurement meaning still needs review. A source is not excluded because its engine has not yet been reviewed.

prerequisite_profiles.endpoint: Read an already exposed/reachable endpoint; inspect exact release, HELP/TYPE, labels and buckets. Do not enable metrics or change workload configuration automatically.
prerequisite_profiles.derived: Validate input units, populations, time windows and identities; handle resets and membership changes. All input acquisition/configuration restrictions remain in force.
prerequisite_profiles.gpu: Supported NVIDIA driver and NVML/DCGM access; per-device/partition field capability and freshness checks. GPU profiling counters may require elevated permissions and conflict with other tools.
prerequisite_profiles.host: Read access to the actual host/namespace procfs/sysfs and relevant accounting interfaces; verify kernel/configuration, process lifetime and source units.
prerequisite_profiles.cgroup: Verified cgroup version/hierarchy and read access. The named catalog interfaces are cgroup v2; no v1 fallback implementation is assumed.
prerequisite_profiles.bpf: Supported collector-specific attachment points (scheduler tracepoints or validated uprobes) and BPF/perf/tracing permissions; validated attachment and event-loss accounting. No application code change is intended; host authorization/capability is still required.
prerequisite_profiles.rdma: Supported RDMA/NIC driver, device/port counter exposure and read access. Verify native units, reset/saturation behavior and per-port link mode; workload attribution is a separate join.
prerequisite_profiles.net: Read relevant network-namespace interface/protocol statistics; distinguish virtual/physical layers and aggregate/detail counters. TCP sources do not measure RDMA payload traffic.
prerequisite_profiles.switch: External vendor/controller interface and read credentials; no specific switch API, counter schema or cadence is established. Host-only completeness is not claimed.
prerequisite_profiles.trace: Compatible existing trace output or supported instrumentation path. Generating records may need plugin loading, process injection, configuration/restart and profiling permission. Strict host-only coverage is not established.
prerequisite_profiles.semantic: Explicit existing semantic records or a new supported integration. Required event IDs, boundaries, population and completeness must be established before reporting the metric.
prerequisite_profiles.unresolved: Keep the original requirement and source. Review relevant TGI, Triton, TensorRT-LLM and other sources; do not require an equivalent in the three engines reviewed first.
